description.value: Vegan Fried Chick'un is a fully plant-based fast-food restaurant on Fraser Street in Vancouver specializing in vegan fried chicken alternatives, Asian-inspired comfort food, burgers, wraps, poutines, and desserts. Every item on the menu is vegan, making it a reliable stop for plant-based cyclists who might otherwise struggle to find cruelty-free options in the fast-food landscape. The restaurant offers takeout, online ordering, and dine-in seating in a casual setting, and can also host group events.
